dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I bought this phone here, but it doesn't work.

dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. How long ago did you buy it?

dialogue.translation: Saba ka taa. Bala ayi fòomulaari wo oni alaa. Jùn tin'in, ayi ka tɛmɛ fo ka jògidaala ka fòsa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. So I give you the faulty phone back, and I get a new one?
dialogue.translation: Aw bɛɛ. O wo ay ka tɛmɛ fo sinji ka fòsa, ay ka filila tɛmɛ fo ka taa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. And if you need more help, just ask me.
dialogue.translation: Saba ka taa. N'a i mɛn ka jògidaala beeshë, o wo ay ka kɛlɛ.

dialogue.translation: Eɛ, jɛmba kanu bɛ sini. Nka a bɛɛ wɔrɔsira kɛ kɔnɔni.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. My apartment is small too, but it's near a quiet street.
dialogue.translation: N ka muso. N ka sira wuli bɛɛ, nka a bɛɛ tɛnja sokolo sini.

scenario: Making plans for the next day

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to do in the morning tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: I jɔn cɛn, i bɛ se ka san dɔɔni san kɛ?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I don't know. Maybe we can meet at the usual place before 9?
dialogue.translation: Ayɛmɛn. Mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka dɔnkɛlɛ 9 san jɔn an ka fɛ kanw la?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's early for me, but I can call you later to confirm.
dialogue.translation: N san sɔgɔsɔgɔnin ye n ka fɔlɔ, nka, ayɛlɛman mɔgɔ min bɛ se ka fɔlɔ kan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Okay, but don't call too late because I go to sleep early.
dialogue.translation: Waati min bɛ, nka, fɔlɔn tɛmɛn’i sababu ayɛlɛman sɔgɔsɔgɔnin ye ayɛ jɔn.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll call before 8. Then we can have a good day.
dialogue.translation: Sɪɲɛɲɪn, ayɛlɛman bɛ se ka fɔlɔ 8 san jɔn. An bɛ san fɔlɔw kan.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'm sure it will be a nice day.
dialogue.translation: Saba. Ayɛlɛman sɪɲɛɲɪn bɛɛ san tɛmɛn’i ye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I tried, but it doesn't work. I really don't understand why.

scenario: Talking about a recent film or book
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: A bɛ fɛ film dɔn dɔnkanw bɛɛ TV dɔnkanw la.
'Good' kan ka kɛlɛyaŋ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I watched a new film last night. It was very good!
dialogue.translation: Film ka tɔɔn beogɔ ye. A bɛɛ bɛɛrɛ!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh really? What's the story about?
dialogue.translation: A tɛna? Tɔgɔ min bɛ yɛrɛ fɛ?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's about a man who travels back in time. But the end is a bit strange.
dialogue.translation: A bɛ yɛrɛ wani min ka tɛmɛ jɔlen kanu. Nka, a sɛbɛn tɛ bɛɛrɛ sɔrɔ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting. I only read the book, not the film.
dialogue.translation: A yɛrɛ sira kan. N' ka kɔnɔkɔlɔ feerɛ sɔrɔ, film mɔnɔn.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The film is better than the book, I think. But then I haven't read it.
dialogue.translation: Film ka saba kɔnɔkɔlɔ la, ayi ye. Nka laban, n' man feeri a ye.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: After I finish my exams, I'll watch it. Thanks for the recommendation!
dialogue.translation: Jɛni n ka tɛmɛ jɔlenw ka sɛbɛn, n bɛ a beogɔ. I jaɲi kɛlɛya la!

key_phrases.phrase: The end is a bit strange

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning. I have a few questions for you. First, why do you want this job?
dialogue.translation: An bɛ sɛgɛ. Ayi la ka fajimakɛla jɛnɲɔgɔnya. A yɛrɛ, i kɛnɛma sɛbɛ ka taa laa ka masaya?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I really like working with people, and I have some experience in customer service.
dialogue.translation: Ne ka jɔ kɛ masaya dɛmɛ donw ka to. Ayi bɛɛ, ne kaɲaɲin ye kɛ kɔlɔnikɛlaw kanu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. Also, can you work on weekends?
dialogue.translation: A yɛrɛ. Ka i masi kɔnɔni tilew la?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that is possible. I can work on Saturdays and Sundays.
dialogue.translation: Ee, a to jati fɛ. Ne hakɛ masi tile laafɔn dɔn dɔn.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good. When can you start?
dialogue.translation: Saba. I hakɛ masi wane?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I can start next week because I need to give notice at my current job.
dialogue.translation: Ne hakɛ masi kɔnɔni bɛɛn. A bɛɛ, ne sɔrɔla kɛlɛ ka faaju kɛnɛma masaya ra.

dialogue.text: What do you want to eat for dinner?

dialogue.text: I like pasta, but I don't want anything heavy tonight.
dialogue.translation: Ayɛ pasta bɛ, nka ayi bɛ sabu kanu bɛn ka taa min bɛ ye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have some chicken and vegetables in the fridge. That could be good.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: A yɛrɛ yɛrɛ bɛrɛ. Nka ayɛ sɔrɔnin bɛ sabu kanu bɛ ye ka taa ye fana.

dialogue.speaker: A

vocabulary.note: ‘Rent an apartment’ (kari un apartemɛn) kanu ye a b’a flo.
Ameriki kanw ye fɔlɔ a ka ‘flat’ tɛ Angalɛ kanw la.
A fɔlɔw bɛɛ kanu b’a flo tɛ a ka jamana ka taa ye.
Jamana ka kɔrɔfililaba; a na fɔlɔw ka kɔrɔba kɔfɛ kanu b’a flo.
‘Cost’ ye a ka jujɛ.
A na fɔlɔw ka sira kɔfɛ kanu b’a flo.
A tɛ ‘suelo’ bɛɛ ye, nka kɔgɔ ye a ka tɛmɛ taa la.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I want to rent an apartment. Is it available now?
dialogue.translation: Sanu, ayi ka apartemɛn kan ka kari. A faamu ye walisa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it is available. The rent is 800 dollars per month.
dialogue.translation: Ee, a faamu ye. Kari ka sira 800 dolare kalo dama ye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Does that price include water and electricity?
dialogue.translation: A sira fɔlɔw ka tɛmɛ kanu b’a flo dɔw ka lanin tɛ balan?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it includes only water. Electricity is extra.
dialogue.translation: A’ ye, a fɔlɔw ka tɛmɛ kanu b’a flo dɔw ye. Balan tɛ a ka jujɛ ye.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And what floor is it on? Is it near a supermarket?
dialogue.translation: Kɔgɔn o bɛna? A kɛlɛ suupɛmarkɛ ka tɛmɛ ye?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's on the third floor, and it's between two big supermarkets. Maybe you can visit it tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: A bɛna kɔgɔ sanakɔ, o bɛɛ, a kɔrɔni suupɛmarkɛ ka tɛmɛ ye. Fɔmɔɲɛmɔɲɛnin o ta a ka tɛmɛ kanu b’a flo sɔgɔsɔgɔnin.

key_phrases.translation: A sira fɔlɔw ka tɛmɛ kanu b’a flo...?
